newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via over-the-weekend system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via over-the-weekend system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system Friday via over-the- weekend system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokesman said.

The Fed's move took place around 1030 EST/1530 GMT, about an hour before the central bank's usual intervention time. Analysts said, however, the anticipated add move has no monetary policy implications.
At the time of the intervention, the federal funds rate was quoted at 5-3/4 percent, well above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.
